candidates.statement: REGULATORY ACTION GUIDANCE: Lots of condoms that are rejected based on the criteria in Attachment A - Sampling Inspection Plan are subject to direct reference seizure. Divisions should forward seizure recommendations to the Division of *Office of Medical Device and Radiological Health Operation (OMDRHO) in consult with*the Division of Enforcement, Office of Enforcement and Import Operations, Office of Regulatory Affairs, Food and Drug Administration.
candidates.context: 3200. For lots greater than 3200, multiple sampling will be used. The FDA plan is described in Attachment A - Sampling Inspection Plan. SPECIMEN CHARGES: Note: Charges for seizure of devices do not include allegations of shipment in interstate commerce because allegations of interstate commerce are not required to support seizure of devices [see section 304(a)(2)] and FDA's jurisdiction to bring enforcement actions involving devices is presumed under section 709 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (the Act).
